feature_plan.history: 8 past decision positions, last action one-hot and consecutive Wait count; public observations and past actions only

learning_settings.q_learning: Lagged online-greedy/frozen evaluation targets every100 updates; TD clip5, L2 bound100
learning_settings.sarsa: Actual sampled next behavior action; TD clip5, L2 bound100

liveness_formula: official reward + .10*(old public Manhattan-new public Manhattan) - .04 if a movement revisits one of the previous4 decision positions - .02 if Wait streak>=3 and at least one currently sensed free adjacent unvisited-in-last8 cell exists. No shortest-path or future-state shaping. Not claimed policy invariant.
selection: Development only: highest successes, then long-route successes, fewer collisions, fewer unproductive Waits with currently observed unvisited alternatives, higher official return, lower successful mean steps, lower training budget. Phase2 baseline may remain selected. No heldout outcome enters ranking.
final_evaluation: One final run after selected IDs/hashes locked. Exactly same64 cases and evaluation seeds for selected4, original Phase2 selected4, non-RL replanner and Random. Identical policy IDs may alias one executed replay per case. No tuning after this run.
acceptance: Actual bounded training for4 families, correct native update/save/load/history, disjoint layout/structural/family audit, one heldout evaluation, true CSV/replays and visible failures. No minimum score promise.
preservation: No writes to archive or Phase2 runs/selection/reports/checkpoints; only path-level Git preservation checks.
